title: Chip cold plate power step
line: A transient conjugate heat transfer FEA study of a water-cooled aluminum block after a 50 W power step.
description: Warm-up of a 6061 aluminum block, 80 x 40 x 12 mm, with one straight 6 mm water channel at 0.25 m/s, after a 20 x 20 mm die switches on at 50 W. The study returns the die temperature through 150 s and the outlet water temperature; the water warms 1.7 K and the die settles near 46 C with a time constant near 35 s.
thumbnailAlt: Temperature of a water-cooled aluminum block under a 50 W die, solved in RunMat
